description.value: Kun's Omakase Bar is an intimate Japanese restaurant in Richmond offering seasonal omakase-style dining, with a focus on fresh, quality ingredients and personalized customization. Executive Chef Kun's team aims to educate guests about authentic Japanese cuisine while adapting dishes to individual tastes. The restaurant currently operates as regular dine-in with delivery available through Uber Eats.
